text:
My day starts at six-thirty when my alarm clock rings. After a quick shower, I make a simple breakfast of porridge and coffee while checking the news on my phone. I leave for work by eight and spend the morning answering emails and attending meetings. I always take a thirty-minute walk during my lunch break to get some fresh air. In the afternoon, I focus on projects and complete reports before finishing at five.

When I get home, I change into comfortable clothes and go for a thirty-minute run in the park. After dinner, I relax by reading a book or watching a documentary. I try to be in bed by eleven, as having a consistent routine helps me stay productive and calm throughout the week.
